## 1. Prediction market

**The gap widens by 7.25 points.** In the confirmed reading of October 20 at 19:55 BRT, the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 80.10% for Flávio Bolsonaro (USD 23.76M) and 19.50% for Lula (USD 27.44M). Against the confirmed reading of October 19 at 15:42 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 3.25pp and Lula falls 4.00pp; since the pair's sum went from 100.35 to 99.60, the normalized move is 3.84pp for each side. The gap goes from 53.35pp to 60.60pp. Cumulative volume in the presidential book totals USD 189.68M.

**When the price moved.** In the recorded readings of the [contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election)'s series, Flávio Bolsonaro stood at 77.00% and Lula at 22.50% at 13:30 BRT on October 20; the move to the confirmed reading came after that, and the panel does not link it to any event in that interval.

**Supreme Court and inflation.** The contract on the [impeachment of an STF justice before 2027](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stands at 2.80% (USD 0.10M), 1.30pp above the reading of October 19. In the [2026 inflation](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) contract, in the 20:12 BRT reading against the one of October 19 at 15:46 BRT, the 5.00% to 5.49% range goes from 71.65% to 65.20% (USD 28 thousand), the 5.50% to 5.99% range from 14.85% to 15.50% (USD 21 thousand) and the 4.50% to 4.99% range from 11.10% to 12.15% (USD 33 thousand).

## 2. What the polling firms registered

**Two national polls on the same day.** [Alfa Inteligência](https://news.google.?oc=5), with 2,700 in-person interviews from October 15 to 19, gives 48.8% to Flávio Bolsonaro and 45.9% to Lula in total votes and [51.5% to 48.5% in valid votes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPS1JCNFJ0c256Y1Uxc2hQRk4xUFVoaHl2SWdaOXRKeUtlXzkxbmcxLW5WZEhWekVHX0lBQVZHeTJ3cHV6ejhrRU5qMlhaMUhwMnpxZ0FKT0EyY1BzUmtpZVp3WTFhTlJEVTY1MFpIMVZENVk5aU84Ukxnd3NvNW9RbHZ6a1pJQS1yUUFaMFFPZEhCX0hLTEpNQzhyZ3ViQQ?oc=5). [Real Time Big Data](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQRTFKS0VPWjNpaC1KVFEyVDl6NFR1MVRkT1FFdHB2dkoyak9tZ1pjNkpiMUlLVjZGMTh0YjNoY2h6dm1kWURsZUY0THlqbmVObjlfQ3VUbnJtdnZHUU9DY2R2aVh1U3gwNGdXdURPdjdqeWlqSE50SVl6MmZLNWpWNTJUMDRQVUpsLXc?oc=5), with 2,000 telephone interviews across the country in the same period, gives 48% to 45% in total votes and 52% to 48% in valid votes; [35% reject Lula and 33% Flávio Bolsonaro](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOYWluMFpJV0wyTDUyYlVrcXFwMHJPeTNTUEFlSmROYVl4ell1NHFmNVlKT2pzM096QWc1Y2J2bU5YQ3d1YVJzWEthaTNUTm00Nk8zbm1uZDNfd2ZDMDRqckNaYVJhNVZIaERJNXhTc0VNVTEzcGpKX2NmSlBOa3VONHpXczlvODZ2eFRTZ2E5MUpuLTdnajFYRFpHWWtEeUZN?oc=5). Both pollsters' previous waves predate the first round: the second-round simulation was 43% to 43% in Alfa of September 24 and 46% to 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro in Real Time of October 1.

**Twenty-eight after the vote.** Of the twenty-eight national polls conducted after the first round, twenty-five put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead, twenty-two of them by 0.6 to 9 points in total votes and three by 2.2 to 4 points in valid votes; the two Vox Brasil polls put Lula ahead, and PoderData/Aya of October 16 measured a tie in valid votes. The poll side of the panel's chart is now Alfa, the largest sample between the two polls of the day. Left out of the count is the [Gerp daily tracking poll](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQcHpwZnAxbXBOb3ZOSWlzUzc5N3FSN0VXT1VNV3EySXN6ZGF4b3JVMFBGaG5EZUVUQzNhS3RWZWFibkl1SXlkYnBMVG1qVFZvRE5ZYkEtdnBtZ1N4dU15MXZlZTRNelAya2ExQXk2aVhpZnYtaXZKbGJPeXd6YTFUZm5PQk14ajhraDdOd09BQi02bUY0WXc?oc=5) published by Times Brasil, from October 15 to 19, because the release does not give the TSE registration.

## 3. What the press covered

**The secrecy challenge.** On October 20, Lula [filed with the TSE and the Supreme Court](https://news.google.?oc=5) a document authorizing the lifting of the bank, tax and phone secrecy of himself and his family if Flávio Bolsonaro does the same, and André Mendonça became the rapporteur at the TSE, according to [Folha de S.Paulo](https://news.google.?oc=5). [Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro argue](https://news.google.?oc=5) that he should not accept.

**Willer Tomaz and the Ethics Council.** A technical note from the Finance Ministry names the lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro who is investigated with him in the inquiry overseen by Alexandre de Moraes at the Supreme Court, as [the country's largest sports-betting gambler in 2025](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/mercado/2026/10/amigo-de-flavio-willer-tomaz-movimentou-r-5-bi-em-bets-e-foi-maior-apostador-do-brasil-diz-fazenda.shtml), with R$ 5 billion wagered, according to Folha de S.Paulo and [O Globo](https://oglobo.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/10/20/advogado-amigo-de-flavio-bolsonaro-foi-o-maior-apostador-do-pais-em-2025-aponta-documento-do-ministerio-da-fazenda.ghtml). The government leader in Congress, Randolfe Rodrigues, [is collecting signatures](https://valor.globo.com/politica/eleicoes-2026/noticia/2026/10/20/parlamentares-coletam-assinaturas-para-denncia-contra-flvio-bolsonaro-ao-conselho-de-tica.ghtml) for a complaint to the Senate Ethics Council that seeks the loss of Flávio Bolsonaro's mandate, citing his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro; the document [has yet to be filed](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/colunas/painel/2026/10/randolfe-denuncia-flavio-bolsonaro-no-conselho-de-etica-do-senado-por-pedido-de-r-134-milhoes-a-vorcaro.shtml).

**Lulinha.** The Federal Police [asked for an extension](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/10/20/pf-pede-prorrogacao-de-inqueritos-sobre-possivel-trafico-de-influencia-de-lulinha.ghtml) of the inquiries into alleged influence peddling by Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's son, and Justice Edson Fachin [is to decide the request](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/fachin-deve-decidir-pedido-da-pf-de-prazo-extra-para-investigacao-sobre-lulinha/). PT lawmakers [signed the request for a congressional inquiry (CPI)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5) into him and [are gathering signatures](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQQUdqUTZCVmJMX0MxSGdQZ1BlUm1BaG80NHhfWGxRVDFCRXBlalVYUkVuM185NHJHTkZ0WUVVOExIRmN2TVNxTE9ibk9qWDQzd1NFZjlZMlJCbGhlb05ZS3lKWUlsWWtINEUtU3JRRE5XNXo0QnJmRUpwNl9SXzhqT1BuSllDZzFhUXBSQlFKbUF5bE9YUnZqY2ROV2VNMGZ6eTBxUEZlZWZ0WmNu?oc=5) for another one targeting Flávio Bolsonaro.

**Meta.** In response to the 24-hour deadline set by TSE Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze, Meta [told the court](https://news.google.?oc=5) that it applies the same criteria to content from Lula and from Flávio Bolsonaro and [asked for a meeting with the justice](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5). Globo's debate is scheduled for October 23, and both campaigns [confirmed attendance](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market × polls:** the [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) pays 80.10% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and the two national polls of the day put him ahead by 2.9 and 3 points in total votes, with margins of 1.9 and 2. Price measures the probability of winning on October 25, and the poll measures voting intention during each one's fieldwork.

> **Poll × press:** Times Brasil published that the distance in Flávio Bolsonaro's favor is widening in the [Gerp tracking poll](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQcHpwZnAxbXBOb3ZOSWlzUzc5N3FSN0VXT1VNV3EySXN6ZGF4b3JVMFBGaG5EZUVUQzNhS3RWZWFibkl1SXlkYnBMVG1qVFZvRE5ZYkEtdnBtZ1N4dU15MXZlZTRNelAya2ExQXk2aVhpZnYtaXZKbGJPeXd6YTFUZm5PQk14ajhraDdOd09BQi02bUY0WXc?oc=5). The change is in valid votes, from 52% to 48% on October 16 to 53% to 47%; in total votes, the pollster repeats 50% to 45%.

> **Debate × polls:** the fieldwork of Alfa and Real Time runs from October 15 to 19, and only the last day comes after the Band debate. In the [TSE registry](https://divulgacandcontas.tse.jus.br/divulga/), the first national poll with its entire fieldwork after the debate is 100 Cidades, on October 19 and 20, with release on October 21.

## In summary

1. **The two national polls of October 20 put Flávio Bolsonaro ahead by 2.9 and 3 points in total votes**, and twenty-five of the twenty-eight conducted after the vote put him in front.
2. **The [winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election) takes Flávio Bolsonaro from 76.85% to 80.10%**, and the gap widens from 53.35pp to 60.60pp.
3. **Lula filed with the TSE and the Supreme Court the conditional lifting of his records' secrecy**, and the Federal Police asked for more time in the inquiries into Lulinha.
